Sam: Quick heads-up — RC cutoff in 45m and full code freeze in 1h. If you need a late exception, post short justification + PR link here. release-bot will gate.
Maya: I have a small API patch (PR 5482) that adds an optional `user_locale` query param. Backwards compatible but client libs will want a version bump.
Alex: Can we avoid a client bump by keeping default behavior identical? Paste the handler change.
Maya: ```python
def handle(req):
    locale = req.args.get('user_locale') or 'en-US'
    # rest unchanged
```
Behavior unchanged if param omitted.
Jordan: I can review now. Quick check: added tests? changelog?
Maya: Added unit tests + one-line changelog entry in PR body. Canary deployed to staging: https://canary.example.com/5482
release-bot: Canary check: baseline 0 regressions, 2 flaky tests flagged (non-blocking). CI: main green. Tagging @eng-sre for rollout waiver.
Tasha: I approve a one-off exception if canary stays stable for 30m. :thumbsup: /cc @Sam
Linh: Holding cutoff by 30m to let canary finish. If green, we'll merge with label `late-exception` and document rollback steps in PR.
Sam: Thanks. If merged, ensure PR body notes semver decision and changelog. Keep the change minimal — no infra touch. If anything weird, revert immediately and we proceed to next patch window.
